messages:
jon r: Quick question — our browser/mobile SDKs fall back to REST when gRPC-web isn't available. That fallback is changing how quotas and routing labels show up at the edge. Anyone worried about canary routing and quota attribution when we translate proto->json on the gateway?

maria g: Yep. We've seen per-tenant quotas get credited to the edge-proxy service instead of the tenant because the proto route label gets lost during translation. :grimacing: Suggest we preserve explicit route headers like `x-rw-tenant` and `x-rw-model` during translation.

kevin: For mobile we prefer JSON, so translation is unavoidable. We could base64 the original proto metadata into a header: `X-RW-Proto-Meta: base64(...)` then routing can decode. Example: ```X-RW-Proto-Meta: eyJ0ZW5hbnQiOiAiYWNjIiwgIm1vZGVsIjogInJlZC1sYXJnZSJ9```

amy: Telemetry concern — if metadata is opaque or base64 we can't easily surface per-route metrics in the console. Need a deterministic header mapping so dashboards and SLOs can parse route keys.

jon r: Proposed minimal contract for gateway translation: 1) copy important proto route labels -> `x-rw-<label>` headers, 2) set `x-rw-original-proto=true`, 3) include `x-rw-routing-key` that our smart router uses for canary/quotas. That keeps routing/quotas stable and gives console parsable signals.

sre-bot: runbook-check: gateway-canary supports header passthrough. Suggest test steps: `./run_tests/gateway_headers.sh` then `./scripts/canary_gw.sh --pct 5 --verify-quotas`.

kevin: Sounds good. Two follow-ups: 1) what do we do if fields are missing/malformed? fallback to default route. 2) proto schema will evolve — header names need versioning.

maria g: Agreed on versioning. Add `x-rw-routing-v=1` so the gateway + console can evolve mapping without breaking dashboards.

amy: UX ask from product: can we have a dashboard tile that shows "translated requests" vs "native gRPC" during rollouts? PMs want visibility into fallback ratio and any QoS delta.

jon r: I'll draft a short RFC for the header contract + console metrics. Implementation plan: gateway mapping + `x-rw-routing-key` insertion, telemetry tag `translated=true|false`, dashboard tile, 5% canary next Wed.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: gateway-canary v3 -> canary=5% at 2024-06-12T17:30Z

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll add mobile SDK changes to emit `x-rw-client-prefers=json` so gateway knows translation intent.

maria g: Nice. Also add an alert if translated requests > 20% in a tenant during canary (could indicate network issues).

jon r: Thanks all — RFC incoming. Will ping when it's up.
